name: James Meyers
description: Born June 2003. Appears throughout the 2017–2018 journals in car rides, lego league, NSP musical rehearsals. Good relationship. Now 22.
bio: Youngest sibling. Quiet, introspective, empathetic, encyclopedic recall of geography and history. Fluent in Spanish by 2022. Lost significant weight 2018–2020 through sustained effort. Graduated SUNY Potsdam 2025 with a BA in English Writing, then enrolled in SUNY Canton nursing program. Active in the church college ministry, respected for kindness and dependability.
public_footprint:
James Meyers of Potsdam, NY graduated summa cum laude from SUNY Potsdam in 2025 with a B.A. in English Writing; he was named to the President's List multiple times, inducted into the Sigma Tau Delta English honor society in 2024, and named a 2024 Departmental Scholar for English Writing. He also wrote a 2020 letter to the editor in North Country Now supporting Rep. Elise Stefanik.
Sources: https://meritpages.com/James-Philip-Meyers/6675391; https://potsdam.meritpages.com/stories/James-Meyers-Named-to-SUNY-Potsdam-President-s-List/135213403
